source.map: City of Portland Johnson Creek Basin plan district (PCC 33.537, Map 537-1) and its subdistricts, as Portland Maps publishes them; flood and trail layers as listed in inputs
source.says: The Springwater corridor buffer and vehicle-area setback (33.537.130) reach these sites, on either form; the screen does not measure which lot line abuts the corridor

inputs.taxlots: quadfit s2_lots (data/quadfit_2026-10-30_dd_c6, Metro RLIS taxlots), the lot shapes the screen asks
inputs.subdistricts: plan-subdistricts.geojson, PLDIST JC SUBDIST SOUTH and FLOOD RISK (BPS_Zoning_Code_Layers layer 1, fetched 2026-10-22)
inputs.retrace_taxlots: quadfit s2_lots (data/quadfit s2_lots.parquet of 2026-07-24, Metro RLIS taxlots), used only to take lots out

source.method: Split 2026-11-08 (FOLLOWUPS 58) from the 2026-11-08 johnson-creek-unmeasured-lots tracing, nothing added to it. Taxlots as before: quadfit s2_lots of quadfit_2026-10-30_dd_c6, lots 10% or more inside the plan district. This file: the old tracing less the lots only the South subdistrict or the Flood Risk Area reached (1 sq ft or more in either, more than 100 ft from the Springwater Corridor Trail centreline and more than 2 ft from every taxlot the trail runs through for 50 ft or more), which moved to johnson-creek-land-division-lots. What the old tracing held for any other reason, the corridor reach and the partly covered lots, stays held here.
